mentions.name: Land Cruiser J90 modifications
mentions.description: A set of modifications and repairs to the builder's Toyota Land Cruiser J90, including LED daytime running lights and an off-road LED light bar, a winch, new front tie rod ends, a rear axle pinion bearing fix, a brake caliper repair, a boost chip with turbo tee, and a kill switch.
mentions.problem: The rear axle pinion bearing was loud while driving and the right rear brake caliper was leaking brake fluid from the piston.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Modifications to my Land Cruiser j90

- LED daytime running lights / off-road LED light bar

- Winch

- Front left – tie rod end (both)

- Rear axle – pinion bearing (loud while driving)

- Right rear brake caliper – brake fluid leaking from the piston

- Boost chip (chip + turbo tee), Kill switch
